evidence: A screen on committed products (the crop model's yields, stores and light, the design climate's rain, fog and wind, the clear-sky radiation check, the atlas and drainage grids, the heat and power ledgers) and two bound branches (ecology's diets and nutrients; resources' phosphorus accounts for the sky and the waters), with Earth literature values for each food system. Yields, efficiencies and emission factors are measured on Earth or modelled there and serve as reference points for the Moon's engineered organisms. The study runs no crop, hydrology, climate or ecosystem model and chooses no mix.
reading_rule: Per billion lunar residents unless named: areas km2, water km3 a year, power and heat TW (TW per billion equals kW a person), phosphorus and nitrogen Mt a year, N2O kt N a year and ppb, methane Mt a year and ppm at steady state, structure Gt. Results computed at the two ends are pairs [low-cost end, high-cost end]: every uncertain input at its favourable value, then at its unfavourable one, so each end is one consistent case. Inputs, derived values and capacities are ranges, smallest first: the basis and derived blocks, billions_the_rain_feeds, billions_the_waters_supply, residents_per_km2, the rain on glass and the fog nets' yields (yields_low_to_high and each ring's). Heat is given for two supplies: power from the array (its receivers' losses included) and fusion on the Moon. Land rules: kept_30 and kept_50 keep 30% and half of each zone wild; wild_30_hybrid_20 is the author's compromise, 30% wild and another 20% hybrid, and wild_50_hybrid_20 half wild and another 20% hybrid for comparison. The hybrid land is heavily manicured megaparks and great gardens, so fields, glass, towns and grazing keep outside a rule's wild and hybrid shares (the kept share), and the wild shares count against the land outside the kept share, which differs by rule, so dry_land_share_used compares the rules directly. Mixes: cases[population][land rule]; zone_use_share is each zone's use against its land outside the kept share (grazing on the fog desert included), sea farms against the seas shallower than 200 m, and their phosphorus against what the waters' life can spare; feasible says which ends fit, feasible_to the fraction of the way to the high-cost end, every input moved together, at which the first zone fills, and feasible_range the case there beside the low-cost end.

marks.screen: Numbers computed here: the zones, the fog-net and water screen, every system's costs per billion, the farm-yield sensitivity, every mix and its feasibility.
marks.derived: Arithmetic on cited values: the derived block (CO2 gain and water-use factor in glass, microbial protein electricity across three accounts, the acetate route's electricity to food, glucose's food energy, fish and sea values, produce yields under lamps) and the food-lift check.

mixes.rain_fed_first: The plant-rich diet on fields: rain-fed first, wettest land first; the rest by watering those fields from the seas, then watered fields in the fog desert; ecology's grazing on the fog desert.
mixes.greenhouse_heavy: Half the plant foods in vented sunlit glasshouses on the highlands beside the towns, half on rain-fed fields; the animal part as aquaponic fish fed from the fields.
mixes.fog_desert_glass: All plant foods and the fish feed in vented glasshouses in the fog desert, watered by rain on the glass and pipes from the seas; the animal part as aquaponic fish; the rain belt left to the wild.
mixes.power_heavy: Vegetables and fruit in lamp-lit vertical farms, the animal part as microbial protein on power, the rest of the plant foods on rain-fed fields.
mixes.fully_lamp_lit: Every plant food in lamp-lit vertical farms on a potato-like staple, the animal part as microbial protein: no farmland.
mixes.power_made: No farmland: microbial protein for half the reference diet's protein and fungal protein fermented on sugar made from power for the other half, sugar made by electrochemistry for the food energy, vegetables and fruit from lamp-lit farms.
mixes.sea_supported: The animal part from the fresh seas, half as macroalgae and half as filter-feeding shellfish; the plant foods on rain-fed fields.

seas_phosphorus.reading: Sea farms draw on what the waters' life can spare: 30% of each water's dissolved input, a design guess of resources' study for the largest harvest that leaves the food webs whole.

night.strategy: Evergreen crops store carbon by day and idle at a quarter of their daytime upkeep once their own carbon balance turns negative; the day fruit is set at sunrise and ripe at sunset, so the harvest comes once a cycle at dusk and the towns hold a cycle of food.

irrigated_fields.what: Field crops watered to the crop model's yield; the water is lifted from the seas and lakes to the zone's mean height and piped its mean distance.

fog_nets.method: The ring products give fog and the mean 10 m wind speed in 10-degree bins of hour angle over every land column and snapshot, the speeds to 0.1 m/s, and hold no pairing of fog and wind snapshot by snapshot. Each bin's instantaneous speeds are spread as a Weibull distribution about its mean. The low-yield end takes a Rayleigh spread (shape 2), fog and wind independent within the bin, the bin means rounded down and the poorer ring; the high-yield end takes each ring's whole-cycle spread (shape fitted to its median and 90th-percentile wind, day-night swing included), the fog in the windiest share of each bin, the means rounded up and the better ring. The bracket takes the two rings on the fog desert's latitudes, 45 N and 45 S; the tilted rings are shown beside them.

power_made_food.note: Sugar supplies the food energy the protein and the produce leave; the fats and the many plant compounds of a varied diet have no measured electrochemical route.

rain_fed_and_watered_fields.how: Evergreen crops idle at a quarter of their daytime upkeep on their own carbon balance; the day fruit is set at sunrise and ripe at sunset, so the harvest comes at dusk and towns hold a cycle of food.

sunlit_glasshouses.how: As the fields under the glass, on the crops' own stores; or lamps through the dark hours, which grow that share of the food at the vertical farms' electricity per kcal.

vertical_farms.how: Lamps on their own clock; the night's energy must come from storage, a day-side grid, fusion or the array.

microbial_protein.how: Reactors on firm power, or on day-side power with hydrogen stored through the night.

aquaponics.how: Fish fed on a 24-hour routine from stored feed; the vegetables on the fish water idle through the night like the glasshouse crops.

sea_farms.how: Macroalgae idle through the night on their stores: Arctic kelp keeps its photosynthesis through 4 months of polar night and survived 7 months of darkness, against the lunar night's 15 days; shellfish feed on plankton that idles with them.
